test_title: PYST 13: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 194 932 446 225 493 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.) What will be the resultant if the first digit of the highest number is added to the second digit of the lowest number?
solution:
The given three-digit numbers are: 194, 932, 446, 225, 493.

The highest number is 932. Its first digit is 9.

The lowest number is 194. Its second digit is 9.

Perform the addition.

Add the first digit of the highest number 9 to the second digit of the lowest number 9.

9 + 9 = 18.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
